writeBoundaryNotes.packages/ui/package.json: The single declared integration edit that touches a shared file. The exports map publishes only `.`, `./contracts`, `./contracts/props`, `./leaves/*` and `./branches/*`, so StatRow cannot be imported as a specifier. Adding `./composites/*` is additive: it publishes a path that did not resolve before and changes no existing entry.

findings.summary: fleet.fixture.json spells two statuses in camelCase (awaitingDns, notProvisioned) while FleetStatus is snake_case (awaiting_dns, not_provisioned). STATUS_TONE[status] returns undefined for those two, so the Cho DNS badge renders neutral where the record own tokens line promises warning.
findings.whyTypeScriptMissedIt: the JSON is cast with an `as ReadonlyArray<Resource>` assertion, which silences exactly the check that would have caught it.
findings.whyNotFixedHere: an amber badge where a grey one was approved is visual drift, and Apply does not change an approved artifact. It returns to Preview as 1.5.

findings.severity: accessibility defect, frozen by the seal
findings.summary: titled-summary-filter-over-body-page declares no host, so the screen outermost node is a div and the document has zero main landmarks. A reader cannot skip to content.
findings.whyNoRuleCaughtIt: routed-page-is-a-main-landmark fires only on a layout that composes chrome. Nothing yet reports a screen that opens no landmark at all.
findings.whyNotFixedHere: same reason: it changes the approved DOM. Returns to Preview as 1.5, and canon needs the missing rule.
